spans.s:
गूढ (or Ved. गूऌह), अस्, आ, अम्, covered,
hidden, concealed, invisible, secret, private; dis-
guised; (अम्), n. a solitary or private place; a private
part; a mystery.
—गूढ-चार, अस्, ई, अम्, one
who goes about secretly or unknown; (अस्), m. a
secret emissary.
—गूढ-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going
about secretly or privately; (ई), m. a secret emissary,
a spy.
—गूढ-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born privately; (अस्),
m. the son of a concealed birth, born secretly of a
woman whose husband is absent, the real father
being unknown; (this is one of the twelve forms
particularized in Hindū law, the child belonging to
the husband of the disloyal wife); [cf. गूढोत्-
पन्न.]
—गूढ-ता, f. concealment, secrecy;
गूढतया, privately, secretly.
—गूढ-त्व, अम्,
n. concealment, secrecy.
—गूढ-नीड, अस्, m. the
wagtail.
—गूढ-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the plant Capparis
Aphylla, = करीर; another plant, Alangium Hexa-
petalum, = अङ्कोठ.
—गूढ-पथ, अस्, m. a
hidden path; the mind, intellect; a bye-path, a
private way.
—गूढ-पाद्, त्, m. a snake.
—गूढ-
पाद, अस्, आ, अम्, having hidden feet; (अस्), m. a
snake.
—गूढ-पुरुष, अस्, m. a spy, a secret
emissary, a disguised agent.
—गूढ-पुष्पक, अस्,
m. the plant Mimusops Elengi, = वकुल.
—गूढ-
फल, अस्, m. the jujube, = बदर.
—गूढ-
भाषित, अम्, n. secret intelligence, private com-
[]
munication.
—गूढ-मार्ग, अस्, m. a subterranean
passage, a bye-road or secret way; a defile.
—गूढ-
मैथुन, अस्, m. a crow (copulating in secret).
—गूढ-वर्चस्, आस्, m. a frog.
—गूढ-वल्लिका,
f. Alangium Hexapetalum, = अङ्कोठ.
—गूढ-
साक्षिन्, ई, m. a concealed witness, one placed by
the plaintiff so as to overhear what has been said
by the defendant.
—गूढागूढ-ता, f. or गूढा-
गूढ-त्व, अम्, n. (fr. गूढ + अगूढ), conceal-
ment and publicity.
—गूढाङ्ग (˚ढ-अङ्˚), अस्,
m. a tortoise.
—गूढाङ्घ्रि (˚ढ-अङ्˚), इस्, m. a
snake.
—गूढार्चि (˚ढ-अर्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, of con-
cealed glory.
—गूढार्थ-दीपिका (˚ढ-अर्˚), f.
‘light for the hidden meaning,’ title of a commen-
tary.
—गूढोत्पन्न (˚ढ-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, born
secretly; (अस्), m. = गूढ-ज, q. v.
गूढ गूढ. See under rt. 1. गुह् last col.
